songs.name: And We Bid You Good Night

ai_show_review.summary: High‑energy Alligator jam and tight The Other One sequence
ai_show_review.blurb: Features a blazing Alligator > Drums > Alligator > Caution suite, a fiery Turn On Your Lovelight opener, and an intense The Other One/cryptical envelopment medley. Jerry’s guitar work and the dual‑drum interplay drive the high‑energy set, captured on two soundboard sources.
ai_show_review.review: The Shrine Exposition Hall show delivers one of late‑1968’s most electrifying performances. From the moment the band launches into Turn On Your Lovelight the energy is unmistakable, but it’s the Alligator > Drums > Alligator > Caution sequence that becomes the night’s centerpiece – a tightly woven jam where Jerry’s searing leads weave through Phil’s burning bass and the twin‑drum engine of Bill and Mickey locks into an almost telepathic groove. The Other One, sandwiched between two Cryptical Envelopments, rides a dark, psychedelic tide that showcases the group’s improvisational daring, while Pigpen’s subtle organ textures add depth to the set’s closing Feedback and And We Bid You Good Night. Two soundboard recordings exist; Charlie Miller’s cut stands out for its crisp vintage tone and balanced mix, making it the definitive listening choice.

best_recording.reason: Miller soundboard offers excellent clarity, balanced mix and only minimal tape hiss, preserving the full impact of the Alligator jam and dual‑drum interplay.

song_highlights: And We Bid You Good Night

band_performance.Jerry: His guitar work is front‑and‑center, delivering soaring leads on the Alligator jam and driving the melodic thrust of The Other One.
band_performance.Phil: Bass lines are full of fire, especially during the Caution jam where his low‑end underpins the dual‑drum surge.
band_performance.Bob: Provides solid rhythm guitar foundation and joins in the sing‑along finale on And We Bid You Good Night.
band_performance.Mickey: Together with Bill, Mickey’s drumming forms a tightly synchronized engine that propels the high‑energy segues throughout the set.
band_performance.Billy: Delivers crisp, driving patterns that lock perfectly with Mickey, especially evident in the Alligator > Drums transitions.
